en-US.description: E-invoice organization and reimbursement preparation tool.
en-US.longDescription:
InvoiceFlowAI turns PDF, OFD, and XML e-invoices from your mailbox, plus supported invoice download links, into organized files and an Excel reimbursement summary. It is designed for individuals, freelancers, and small teams that manually collect multiple e-invoices each month. Connect your own QQ Mail or 163 Mail account to collect invoices in batches, run OCR, archive them by category, and create a summary while retaining low-confidence results for human review.
Email and invoice files are processed locally. If you enable GLM OCR / vision recognition, invoice images are sent to your configured model provider for extraction.

zh-CN.description: 电子发票整理与报销准备工具。
zh-CN.longDescription:
InvoiceFlowAI 把邮箱中的 PDF、OFD、XML 电子发票和部分发票下载链接，整理成分类文件与 Excel 报销汇总。面向每月需要手工收集多张电子发票的个人、自由职业者和小团队。连接自己的 QQ 或 163 邮箱后，可批量收集发票、OCR 识别、分类归档并生成汇总；低置信度结果保留给用户人工检查。
邮件和发票文件在本地处理。启用 GLM OCR / 视觉识别时，发票图片会发送到你配置的模型服务商用于提取。
